column1: If you could move any of these rocks, you wouldn't need to pack a gun.
column2: 如果你能搬動這些岩石，就不需要帶槍了。

column1: You take the can, look at it, and discard it.
column2: 你拿起罐子看了看，然後丟掉。

column1: It's broken and worthless.
column2: 它壞了，也毫無價值。

column1: After picking it up, you look at the object, which is sharpened to a point. All of a sudden, in your head, a light comes on.
column2: 你撿起物品，發現它被削成尖端。突然間，你腦中靈光一閃。

column1: You remember what the prisoner said; how the suspect held a makeshift knife on the jailer during the escape.
column2: 你想起囚犯說過的話：嫌犯逃獄時曾拿自製刀子抵住獄警。

column1: You slip the knife into your belt and keep it as evidence.
column2: 你把刀子插進腰帶，留作證物。

column1: You see nothing like that. But then, you must be close to objects to see them underwater.
column2: 你沒看到那種東西。不過在水下必須靠近物品才能看見。

column1: It's a real tight fit back here, and you can't see a thing.
column2: 這裡非常狹窄，你什麼也看不見。

column1: ARRGGGHH!!!....This is your final word as blackness overcomes you. Next time, be more aware of the requirements of diving.
column2: 「啊啊啊！！！」……黑暗襲來，這是你最後說出的話。下次要更注意潛水要求。

column1: You'd better get the body out of the river first.
column2: 你最好先把屍體弄出河裡。

column1: Along with the river bottom vegetation, you see many large boulders. An old tire is half buried in the mud. The wreck of a small rowboat lies against the rocks.
column2: 除了河底植物，你還看見許多巨大岩石。一條老輪胎半埋在泥中。一艘小划艇的殘骸靠在岩石旁。

column1: You notice something apparently hidden behind some rocks.
column2: 你注意到有東西似乎藏在一些岩石後面。

column1: You see nothing unusual. You're getting pretty tired of looking at rocks.
column2: 你看不出任何異常。你已經很厭倦看石頭了。

column1: You look at a small school of the "scaly-skinned" sucker fish, otherwise known as "carp". They are incompatible with the gullet due to the numerous amount of bones.
column2: 你看著一小群「鱗皮」吸口魚，也就是俗稱的「鯉魚」。牠們骨頭太多，不適合入口。

column1: It's a WRECK! No way to bail out of this baby!
column2: 這是一艘沉船！沒辦法把這艘小傢伙弄出去了！

column1: Looks like an old wine bottle.
column2: 看起來像一個舊酒瓶。

column1: It's just a water-logged candy wrapper.
column2: 只是一張泡水的糖果包裝紙。

column1: Just a discarded, rusty old can.
column2: 只是被丟棄的生鏽老罐子。

column1: You see a half buried old tire next to the rock face.
column2: 你看見岩壁旁有一條半埋的老輪胎。

column1: It would be better to remove the body from the river first.
column2: 最好先把屍體從河裡移出來。

column1: The rock has been moved.
column2: 岩石已經移動。

column1: In general, moving the rocks down here would stir up a lot of mud.
column2: 一般來說，在這裡搬動岩石會攪起大量泥土。

column1: What body? Where?
column2: 什麼屍體？在哪裡？

column1: You have more important things to do.
column2: 你有更重要的事要做。

column1: You would consume all your air digging that tire out. It wouldn't fit in the patrol car, anyway.
column2: 你會耗盡所有空氣來挖出那條輪胎。而且它也塞不進巡邏車。
